text:
maya: dropping a quick thread on a different spin for the model catalog compare UX. trying a small legend, 'freeze' vs 'lock' naming, and compact keyboard-first flows. figma: https://figma.redwood/variant-compare (frame: variant-ux-1)

sam: liked the legend idea. current problem: users interpret green badges as 'good' not "fast". propose explicit legend pills (bolt = latency, ¥ = cost, star = verified). legend should be tappable to reveal tooltip/context.

elena: a11y first: legend tooltips must be keyboard-focusable and use `role="tooltip"` with accessible names. small numeric badges (e.g., "9 ms") fail contrast in dark mode; bump font to 13px semibold or darken bg. Also provide a table-mode toggle for SR users so we offer semantic headers.

rui: on naming — I prefer "Freeze version" because it's clear it's preventing updates, but the word can sound permanent. microcopy: button = "Freeze version"; toast = "Version v2.0 frozen for Sales workspace (undo)". Make toast `role="status" aria-live="polite"`. Also ensure the freeze control is focusable inside each compare row.

noah: product question: if we freeze a version should it float to the top? customers would expect frozen items prioritized; propose frozen-first sort and a small outline + frozen badge. Also add a workspace banner if any frozen versions exist.

sam: filters: we should add a "show only frozen" toggle. Filter chips are noisy for screen readers; suggest collapsible filter group with `aria-expanded` and a visible count like "Filters (4)". pressing `/` should focus the search box. consider `G` to jump to compare list.

elena: keyboard flow: every row currently has many tiny buttons. Add a single row action menu (aria-haspopup) that contains Lock/Freeze, Compare, and Version history. That reduces tab stops and makes SR flow better. Also add `aria-label` to the Compare selected button and disable it until >1 rows selected.

rui: announcements: when a user toggles view (e.g., Performance vs Details), emit `role="status" aria-live="polite"` saying "Switched to Performance view". For freeze/unfreeze: "Frozen v2.0 for Sales" / "Unfrozen v2.0". Keep announcements short.

maya: UX copy: prefer concise: Button "Freeze version", toast "Frozen v2.0 — Undo". Banner copy: "This workspace has frozen versions. Some routes will not auto-update." with a link to docs in the banner.

noah: telemetry: track `compare.freeze_toggled` with fields: workspace_id, model_id, version, action (freeze/unfreeze). Also `compare.view_changed` for view toggles and `compare.shortcuts_used` for hotkeys.

sam: visual accessibility: show metrics with units and percentile: "9 ms (p95)". Add a tiny info icon that opens a context modal explaining test conditions (seq len, batch).

elena: dark-mode specifics: for numeric chips use bg #07142a and text #e7f2ff (run contrast check), or alternatively use 14px semibold. I'll test both and post results.

rui: small keyboard details: the row action menu should support ArrowUp/Down to move between menu items, Enter to activate, and Escape to close and return focus to row. Provide a skip link at top: "Skip to compare results" with sr-only styles.

maya: action list I'm hearing: 1) add tappable legend with tooltips (sam) 2) decide final naming Freeze vs Lock (product to choose; maya/noah to propose copy) 3) freeze control focusable in row + aria-live toast + undo (rui/maya) 4) frozen-first sorting + outline + workspace banner (noah) 5) collapsible filter group with aria-expanded and shortcut `/` (sam/rui) 6) single row action menu to reduce tab stops (elena) 7) show units + p95 tooltip and test context modal (sam/elena) 8) telemetry events for freeze/view/shortcuts (noah)

product-bot: Frame 'variant-ux-1' updated by maya. Labels suggested: design-review, accessibility, copy, telemetry.

maya: thanks all. i'll iterate on Figma with the legend and the row menu patterns. please add any final rapid feedback here before EOD. :thumbsup:
